operating_metrics._notes: Audited-quality continuing disclosure filed via EMMA. Total operating revenue $2.675B, operating margin 1.8%, EBIDA margin 8.4%, EBIDA $224.054M. Operating income $47.023M. Interest income / non-operating $9.447M. Days cash on hand: 58 (consolidated) / 56 (Obligated Group) vs 45-day MTI covenant — comfortable cushion. Unrestricted cash $400.091M. Long-term debt $1.489B including $12.581M current portion. Interest expense $77.337M + depreciation $99.694M implies MADS ~$165M (~11% of LT debt). Composite covers ~1.35x. Moody's affirmed Baa3 (not upgrade — note user said 'upgraded' but Moody's was an affirmation; S&P upgraded BB+ to BBB- in late 2023).

operating_metrics.fiscal_year: FY2024 (year ended June 30, 2024); DCOH from quarter ended Sept 30, 2025
operating_metrics._notes: Hurley is a component unit of City of Flint; full audit consolidated into Flint's ACFR. Total program revenues $541.442M (charges for services $450.850M + operating grants $90.592M). Total expenses $526.568M => net program revenue $14.874M (~2.7% operating margin). Unrestricted investment appreciation $7.627M. Bonds outstanding: Series 2013A $16.36M + 2013B $5.55M + 2020 $45.27M = $67.18M, plus $10.77M leases + $6.79M SBITA = $84.7M total. FY25 debt service ~$3.515M principal + $2.952M interest = $6.467M. Not in default on debt service coverage / DCOH 50-day covenant as of 6/30/2024. Fitch BBB- affirmed 12/2025 (FY2025 audited revenue ~$555M per Fitch). Moody's upgraded Baa3 from Ba1 in Dec 2024. Days cash on hand 168.2 as of Sept 30, 2025 (Becker's Hospital Review Dec 2025) — far above 50-day covenant and 80-day Series 2016 OS threshold.

Mosaic Life Care / Heartland Regional Medical Center 990 for FY2024 (filed May 2025). Total revenues $782.152M (+7.5% YoY from $727.8M in FY23). Program services $764.924M. Total expenses $763.023M => operating income ~$19.130M (~2.4% margin). Total assets $495.357M; total liabilities $65.724M (low leverage — pre-existing trade press cited ~$714M revenue which was understated). Investment income only $333,634 reported on 990 (likely netted; impact-report cited $393M consolidated revenue — that's NET revenue for one entity, the 782 figure is system 990). Long-term debt not separately broken out on 990 summary. DCOH not disclosed on 990 — would need EMMA filing if any debt outstanding. Note: separate consolidated audited financials at mosaicinfo.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Mosaic-and-Affiliates-2024-Consolidated-Audited-Financial-Statements.pdf were inaccessible via WebFetch and curl (403); would need manual download to refine DCOH and LT debt. _warning: DCOH and long-term debt are NULL — flag for re-fetch.

operating_metrics.fiscal_year: FY2024 (CY 2024, ended Dec 31, 2024); DCOH from FY2023 audited
operating_metrics._notes: Most recent IRS 990 (FY2024 ending Dec 31, 2024) per ProPublica: total revenue $650.125M, expenses $609.403M, net income $40.722M (6.3% operating margin) — strong improvement. Investment income $21.882M. Total liabilities $256.464M. Net assets $370.887M. FY2023 audited statements (Dec 2023 PDF on website): operating revenue $593.676M, income from operations $18.996M (3.2% margin) — FY24 substantially expanded margin. Days cash on hand 191.4 as of Dec 31, 2023 (audited). LT debt at Dec 2023: $95.150M (long-term portion) + $8.150M (current) = $103.3M (much lower than recent 990 total liability figure — 256.464M includes pension and other non-debt liabilities; pure LT debt is ~$103M from 2023 audit). Moody's affirmed Baa2 in Nov 2025 with outlook revised stable→positive. S&P upgraded to BBB+ in 2025.

LLUMC standalone (EIN 95-3522679, 501(c)(3)) FY2024 (ending June 30, 2024) per ProPublica 990 extraction: total operating revenue $1.837B, expenses $1.740B => operating income $96.650M (5.3% margin). Investment income $14.409M. Total assets $3.889B; total liabilities $2.940B. Long-term debt ~$1.7B per Fitch BB+ rating note from prior year (Fitch BBB- now per 2024-25 upgrade). Days cash on hand NOT available from 990 — need EMMA quarterly filing for current DCOH. Rating: Fitch BBB- (upgraded from BB+); S&P BBB; user mentioned 'Moody's Baa1' but Moody's does not appear to currently rate LLUMC — verify. _warning: DCOH null; debt service is an estimate based on $1.7B at ~6% blended rate. Need EMMA disclosure for precise figures.

Cabell Huntington Hospital Inc (EIN 55-0675666) FY2024 (Sept 2024 year-end) per ProPublica 990: total operating revenue $877.045M, expenses $824.956M, operating income $52.089M (5.9% margin). Investment income $7.737M. Total liabilities $451.311M (includes LT debt + pension etc). Net assets $583.224M. Recovered from FY22 ($31M loss) to FY23 ($21.5M income) to FY24 ($52M income) — significantly improved. BUT: Moody's downgraded Baa3 -> Ba1 in 2025 citing 'very weak liquidity' and risk of breach of DCOH covenant if Direct Payment Program (DPP) Medicaid funds NOT received by end of FY25. DPP funding is the swing variable. Days cash on hand specific number NOT publicly disclosed in available sources — Moody's report cited covenant breach RISK suggesting DCOH is near 45-60 day range typical of safety-net Ba1 obligors. Annual debt service estimate at ~11% of LT debt ($50M). _warning: DCOH null but likely 45-75 days based on Moody's covenant-breach-risk language; needs EMMA quarterly disclosure for exact number. Also note: 'Mountain Health Network' renamed to 'Marshall Health Network' in 2024.

key_observations: Disclosure quality varies dramatically at BBB tier. OU Health publishes detailed quarterly EMMA filings with DCOH covenant tracking; Cabell Huntington and Mosaic Life Care effectively rely on annual 990 forms only.

Three obligors (Mosaic, LLUMC, Cabell Huntington) lack publicly extractable DCOH — the most credit-critical metric. Cabell's is the most concerning given Moody's explicit covenant-breach-risk language in the 2025 downgrade rationale.
Two obligors required workarounds: Hurley (component unit of City of Flint, found in Flint ACFR), Mosaic (audit PDF returns 403 to bot agents — site has WAF blocking).
Operating margins at this tier cluster 1.8%-6.3% — none in distress per margin alone. Distress signal is liquidity (DCOH), and that's exactly where disclosure is weakest.

User flagged 'OU Health recently upgraded' but Moody's most recent action was AFFIRMATION at Baa3 (stable). S&P upgraded to BBB- in 2023 (and outlook to positive in 2024). Worth verifying upgrade timeline.
User noted 'Mountain Health Network' for Cabell — the system was renamed 'Marshall Health Network' as of 2024. Search must use both names.
